organism.source: UniProtKB organism_name field (verbatim; the corpus's own values match a direct UniProt REST query byte-for-byte)
organism.approved_use: plan.md Phase 5 (no gate needed — factual UniProt metadata, not a model-generated field): prompt context for reasoned target variants only, rendered via bioreason_pro.data_contract.ORGANISM_COLUMN. Not coupled to the SFT reasoning-evidence requirement (CONTEXT_COLUMNS) — a 60-trace spot check found no reasoning trace names its own protein's organism, so this is a supplementary prediction input, not evidence a trace could fabricate.

protein_function.approved_use: OWNER RULING (plan.md Phase 4, 2026-08-23): adopted alongside final_answer, matching upstream's exact _add_uniprot_summary mechanism — spliced verbatim into the functional-summary line for the leaf_only_reasoned target variant only (bioreason_pro.data_contract.compose_functional_summary). Also gates functional_summary_instruction's conditional instruction text (reads literally "Not known" for a large share of rows; asking for a summary there would train a contradiction).

go_pred.source: GO-GPT's own greedy predictions (models.go_decoder.wanglab/gogpt), full ancestor closure, per-aspect text, precomputed and redistributed as this column by WangLab
go_pred.license: Apache-2.0 as redistributed by WangLab at the pinned revision; the underlying go_decoder (wanglab/gogpt) is itself Apache-2.0, gated=false, confirmed via the HF REST API this session
go_pred.approved_use: OWNER RULING (ADR-037, this session): adopted as a BioReason-Pro prompt field, superseding the 2026-08-23 baseline-only ruling now that (a) the GO-GPT baseline number exists (ADR-033: 0.50059) and (b) a licence check found no blocker (code MIT, weights and encoder Apache-2.0/MIT, none gated). Rendered via bioreason_pro.data_contract.CONTEXT_COLUMNS (not ORGANISM_COLUMN's ungated pattern) — a 60-trace spot check found 56/60 reasoning traces cite a GO id verbatim from this column, so its absence also gates SFT supervision closed (MissingReasoningEvidence), unlike organism. Present and non-empty in 500-row samples of the SFT, RL, and sealed-test datasets alike (go_pred_leaf, by contrast, is SFT-only and stays excluded).

gogpt.provenance: plan.md Phase 5 / ADR-028. Vendored verbatim rather than reimplemented: GO-GPT's architecture (dual protein/GO attention streams, per-aspect tokens, gated attention, beam search tied to a specific trained checkpoint) is custom model code, not a REST client — a from-scratch reimplementation risks a subtle, silent divergence from the real model.
